[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Restore TUI startup time on large-archive hosts[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A sase TUI session on athena is interactive on its visible tab in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]about 3.5 seconds at the median again (it is 6.8-8 s today, from [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]3.25 s in mid-August), every stage of the durable startup telemetry[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]returns to its mid-August band, and the startup-critical path is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]regression-guarded so the next creep is caught by measurement [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of by feel.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Controlled baselines and startup observability gaps[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]baseline[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline: capture controlled quiet-host and busy-host loader benches [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus traced live startups at a recorded deployed SHA, and close the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instrumentation gaps this diagnosis hit - sub-stage spans inside [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agents.load_from_disk, spans for the axe surface first load (none exist [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in live traces today), a pre-mount split of process_start_to_on_mount, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a startup-window marker on spans so startup contention is directly [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]queryable.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the visible surface win the startup window[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]startup-sequence[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]startup-sequence: stop launching every post-mount background load [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]concurrently with the visible tab's first load; sequence or gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-visible-surface work (relations index builds, prompt catalog warm, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detail/prompt panel first renders, monitor reconcile, bead warmups, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dismissed-index sync, proc-shell prune, update checks) behind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]visible-ready with a bounded fallback delay, and deduplicate work that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runs twice in the window today.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cut the bounded Tier 1 load's absolute cost[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]loader-diet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]loader-diet: attribute and reverse the standalone bounded-load creep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](production_bounded p50 1002 ms on 2026-09-13 to 1632 ms on 2026-09-18 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]at +3% archive growth), including the ~11x decode amplification (about [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]1,062 records decoded to return 96 rows) and index row growth, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rust-core pushdown evaluated under the rust_core_backend_boundary rule.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Import-graph diet for process start to on_mount[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]premount-diet[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]premount-diet: bring process_start_to_on_mount back under its mid-August[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]band (0.67-0.76 s median; 1.10 s today) by trimming the TUI app import [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]graph (3,285 modules imported before first paint) and add an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]import-count/time regression guard on the startup-critical path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Attribute and fix the doubled axe surface startup cost[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]axe-ready[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]axe-ready: using the axe spans added in baseline, attribute why [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]axe_ready_seconds doubled (2.0 s to 3.5 s median, step on 2026-08-27/28)[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and restore it to about 2 s, keeping the axe first load off the visible [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]surface's critical path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Trim on_mount to first paint back under 0.3 s[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]first-paint[dim] · [dim][/dim]after baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]first-paint: profile the compose/on_mount/first-refresh path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](on_mount_to_first_paint_seconds doubled from 0.21 s to 0.44 s median) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and remove or defer the growth so first paint lands in about 0.25 s [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]again.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Prove the recovery on athena and pin it with regression guards[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after startup-sequence, loader-diet, premount-diet, axe-ready, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]first-paint[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: capture after-telemetry over real athena sessions at a recorded [/#D7D7AF]
